# Support

Thank you for using **SDS React** (`@skygenesisenterprise/react-sds`), the official React and React Native toolkit of the SGE Design System, maintained by [Sky Genesis Enterprise](https://skygenesisenterprise.com).

## Community support

If you need help with installation, configuration, component usage, or general troubleshooting:

- [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/skygenesisenterprise/react-sds/discussions) — questions, patterns, and ideas.
- [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/skygenesisenterprise/react-sds/issues) — bug reports and feature requests only.
- [Storybook documentation](https://skygenesisenterprise.github.io/react-sds) — interactive component examples.
- Repository guides: [README.md](../README.md), [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), [MIGRATION.md](../MIGRATION.md), [AUDIT.md](../AUDIT.md), and [PROVENANCE.md](../PROVENANCE.md).

## Commercial support

If you use SDS React in a professional or production environment and need priority fixes, custom integrations, design-system consulting, or SLA-backed assistance, contact [support@skygenesisenterprise.com](mailto:support@skygenesisenterprise.com).

## Security concerns

If you discover a security vulnerability, **do not open a public issue**. Report it through a [private security advisory](https://github.com/skygenesisenterprise/react-sds/security/advisories/new) or contact [security@skygenesisenterprise.com](mailto:security@skygenesisenterprise.com). See [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

## Contributing

Want to improve SDS React? Read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [GOVERNANCE.md](../GOVERNANCE.md) before opening a pull request.

Thanks for supporting open source.
